setup.heading: Set Up Your Shared Account
setup.getStarted: ! To get started, you need to create a new space or join an existing one.

create.heading: Create a New Space
create.description: Establish a brand new shared ledger workspace. As the creator, you'll be the owner and can invite other members with an invite link anytime.

join.heading: Join an Existing Space
join.description: Connect to an existing workspace created by someone else. You will need their Invite ID to instantly sync up and share budget ledger logs.
join.inviteIdPlaceholder: Paste the Invite ID from your invite link
join.requestSent: Request sent — the space owner will review it.

tip.label: Tip:
tip.body: You can find your Invite ID inside the user profile menu at the top-right corner of the application once logged in.

hero.title: Track your spending effortlessly
hero.subtitle: Manage your space finances, follow every expense, and keep your goals in sight.
hero.privacyNote: Secure sign-in · Your financial data stays private
